description:
Join the C.LYNN&CO Collective
Earn, share, and represent the elevated standard of sports parent style.

✨ • About our brand and products:

C.LYNN&CO was created for the sports moms, dads, and supporters who show up every day—but refuse to blend in. We design elevated, modern sportswear that feels as good as it looks. Every piece is inspired by real sideline culture, from early mornings at the pool to weekends spent cheering from the stands. Our products combine comfort, quality, and style so our customers feel confident, put-together, and part of something bigger.

💎 • What makes us different:

We’re not your typical “team merch.”
C.LYNN&CO is built on identity.

Our designs are clean, bold, and intentionally styled to feel like premium lifestyle apparel—not throwaway game-day gear. We tap into the emotional side of sports culture—the pride, the dedication, the community—and turn it into something wearable.

When people wear C.LYNN&CO, they don’t just support their athlete…
they represent a lifestyle.

💰 • How affiliates can earn:

As a C.LYNN&CO affiliate, you’ll earn $10 USD for every customer order made through your unique link or code.

To help you convert even more, you’ll also receive a $5 off coupon/link to share with your audience—giving them an instant incentive to shop while increasing your chances of earning on every post.

It’s simple: you share, they save, you earn.

We also prioritize building relationships with our affiliates—meaning opportunities for exclusive codes, featured content, and growth as our brand expands.

📲 • How to promote us:

Promoting C.LYNN&CO should feel natural—because it is.

Share how you show up:
• Sideline fits
• Swim meet weekends
• Game day routines
• Everyday life as a sports parent

Our brand performs best through real, relatable content that highlights both style and lifestyle. Whether it’s Instagram, TikTok, or word of mouth, authenticity is what drives results.

🤍 • Other information:

We’re building more than a brand—we’re building a community of people who take pride in how they show up.

As a C.LYNN&CO affiliate, you’re not just promoting products—you’re representing a standard. One that’s confident, elevated, and rooted in real life.

If that sounds like you, you’re exactly where you belong.
